families.title: Memory fill

families.title: In-place byte transformations

Preserve the supported architecture spans, calling conventions, kernel/userspace guards and existing feature-dispatch fallbacks.

families.title: Terminated-string positions

Preserve the supported architecture spans, calling conventions, kernel/userspace guards and existing feature-dispatch fallbacks.

families.title: Byte and string comparison

families.title: Byte hashes and checksums

families.title: Network byte order and IPv4 text

families.title: Socket operations
